bull_case: Locked Bull value is ~3.28x current price and Adobe has at least three distinct upside paths: AI monetization, broader creative/document user conversion, and enterprise CX/GenStudio, with buybacks amplifying per-share outcomes.
bear_case: Bear value is close to current price only if Adobe's cash engine remains intact; a structural workflow bypass could invalidate the modeled Bear floor rather than merely reduce growth.
thesis: Mechanical asymmetry is stronger than the prior report captured. Locked Bull/current is ~$817.33/$248.92 = 3.28x with at least three independently observable upside paths, mapping upside_path to 90. Locked Bear/current is ~$233.72/$248.92 = 0.939x, mapping permanent_loss to 90. Probability calibration remains 75 because Firefly unit economics and AI-first ARR incrementality are unknown and the DCF is still scenario-dependent.

evidence.claim: Locked Bull/current is ~3.28x and Bear/current is ~0.939x.
AI-first ending ARR exceeded $650M and grew >150% y/y, providing a monetized AI upside path.
Adobe reported >1B creativity/productivity MAU and >100M creative freemium MAU, supporting a user-conversion upside path.
Q3 customer-group subscription revenue grew 14% y/y and TTM OCF is estimated at $10.806B, supporting the modeled residual-value floor.

counterevidence: The Bear DCF is not a liquidation floor; a structural moat break can invalidate its cash-flow assumptions.
AI-first ARR may partly represent bundled or reclassified spend rather than fully incremental revenue.
unknowns: AI-first ARR incrementality and Firefly contribution margin.
Probability of a workflow-level moat break severe enough to invalidate the Bear path.
falsifiers: Bear/current falls below 0.6x after a properly refrozen fundamental downgrade.
AI-driven workflow substitution causes sustained ARR and owner-FCF/share contraction.
The independent upside paths collapse into one shared assumption about generative-AI success.

hard_veto_flags.veto: 파산 또는 영구손실 확률이 기대수익에 비해 지나치게 높음
hard_veto_flags.rationale: Strong recurring OCF and modest leverage rebut financing-driven permanent-loss risk; business-model impairment remains in the Bear/falsifier set.

hard_veto_flags.veto: 현재가격이 비현실적인 Bull Case 이상을 요구
hard_veto_flags.rationale: Current price is far below locked Bull value and below Base.

next_checks: Recompute asymmetry after any DCF refreeze.
Track AI-first ARR composition and cash conversion.
Monitor core subscription growth for evidence the Bear floor is breaking.

subscores.rationale: Observable table: Bull/current ≈3.28x (>2.5x) and at least three independent upside paths are evidenced (AI monetization, broad user conversion, enterprise CX/GenStudio), so 90.
Observable table: Bear/current ≈0.939x (>0.8), so 90. No net-cash modifier applies because Adobe is modestly net debt.
75 anchor: explicit Bear/Base/Bull sensitivity and falsifiers are used; 90 is not warranted because scenario probabilities and AI unit economics remain uncertain.

uncertainties.rationale: Bull/current and three+ monetization/user/enterprise paths satisfy the observable top band.
Bear/current satisfies the top band, but modeled Bear is not equivalent to guaranteed recovery value.
Scenario probabilities are qualitative and AI unit economics remain unresolved.
